$comment: Item table. Contract: docs/GDD.md 'Items and currency' + 'Weapons'. Owned by the `game` agent. Shipped to clients in the `defs` message; never duplicated under client/.

entity_defs.$comment: One def serves every EntityTypeNPC. It was authored for the Phase 2 shopkeeper and `damageable` stayed false when Phase 3 added hostile NPCs, which made every camp grunt and gunner immune to gunfire: ResolveShot skips a non-damageable entity outright, so the camp could be shot at forever and never cleared. Hostiles are damageable; the shopkeeper stays immune because its archetype has no max_health, so it spawns at 0 health and ResolveShot's dead-entity guard drops it before this flag is ever read. max_health here is unused for NPCs - a placement takes its pool from the npcs.json archetype.
